captions.efficiency: Tag-and-probe efficiencies in data and simulation; error bars are statistical. The horizontal axis is probe |eta| for 5 < pT < 10 GeV.
captions.mass_fit_bin_00: Probe bin 0 < |eta| < 0.8, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.547; the resulting scale factor is 0.8993 +/- 0.0629.
captions.mass_fit_bin_01: Probe bin 0.8 < |eta| < 1.4442, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.180; the resulting scale factor is 0.8079 +/- 0.0821.
captions.mass_fit_bin_02: Probe bin 1.4442 < |eta| < 2.5, 5 < pT < 10 GeV. Panels are data pass, data fail, simulation pass, and simulation fail in reading order. The nominal data fit has chi2/ndf=1.204; the resulting scale factor is 1.0374 +/- 0.2243.
captions.scale_factor: Data-to-simulation scale factors with total uncertainties. The horizontal axis is probe |eta| for the single 5-10 GeV pT bin.
captions.scale_factor_heatmap: Two-dimensional scale-factor map; each cell shows the central value and total uncertainty.
